title: dmri_pathstats
description: Compute path statistics for diffusion MRI data based on input .trk file and optional various measures.

measname.description: Name(s) of microstructural measure(s) (as many as volumes)
measname.title: Measure names

dtbase.description: Base name of input dtifit volumes (optional)
dtbase.title: DTI base name

path.description: Name of pathway (optional, written to output files)
path.title: Pathway name

subj.description: Name of subject (optional, written to output files)
subj.title: Subject name

out.description: Output text file for overall path measures
out.title: Overall path measures file

outvox.description: Output text file for voxel-by-voxel measures along path (optional)
outvox.title: Voxel-by-voxel measures file

ends.description: Base name of output volumes of streamline ends (optional)
ends.title: Ends base name

ref.description: Reference volume (needed only if using --ends without --dtbase)
ref.title: Reference volume

pthr.description: Lower threshold on path posterior distribution, as a portion of the maximum (range: 0-1, default: 0.2)
pthr.title: Path posterior threshold

fthr.description: Lower threshold on FA (range: 0-1, default: no threshold)
fthr.title: FA threshold

checkopts.description: Don't run anything, just check options and exit
checkopts.title: Check options flag

help.description: Print out information on how to use this program
help.title: Help
